name: TC-03-vendor-item
description: TC-03: Vendor and Item (Inventory Item) Setup

doc_metadata.title: TC-03 — Vendor List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Vendor. Vendors supply materials, spare parts, and services. Their performance is tracked automatically based on purchase receipts.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03 — Add New
doc_metadata.caption: Click the Add New button to open the creation form.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03 — Fill Vendor Name
doc_metadata.caption: Enter "E2E Vendor — Industrial Parts Co." into the Vendor Name field.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03 — Vendor Created
doc_metadata.caption: The vendor record is created. Performance ratings (delivery, quality, overall) are auto-calculated from purchase receipts. A new vendor starts with default/zero ratings.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Show the vendor with performance rating fields.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03 — Vendor Detail
doc_metadata.caption: The vendor detail shows contact information, performance ratings, and linked purchase orders. Ratings update automatically when purchase receipts are processed.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03 — Item (Inventory) List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Item. Items represent materials, spare parts, and consumables tracked in inventory. They are used in purchase requests, purchase orders, and work order parts.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03 — Add New
doc_metadata.caption: Click the Add New button to open the creation form.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03 — Fill Description
doc_metadata.caption: Enter "E2E Bearing SKF 6206" into the Description field.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03 — Item Created
doc_metadata.caption: The item is created with its name and default properties. Items track stock levels, reorder points, and are linked to stores for inventory management.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Show the item detail with inventory fields.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03 — Item Detail
doc_metadata.caption: The item detail view shows name, unit of measure, stock levels, reorder point, and storage locations. Items are referenced in PR lines, PO lines, and WO parts.
